title: KP14 vyg25s with the loadings DOUBLED: six types -0.28, -0.14, -0.04, 0.04, 0.14, 0.28, level-compensated, price 2.5
question: Does doubling the size of the hidden, mean-zero loading raise room and the gap in KP14, or does the type become linearly visible (as gvyp15/20 did)?

WHY (2026-10-29). The exposure's SIZE has been laddered only for GS21's product (gvyp05/075/10/15/20: room +0.13, +0.29, +0.19, +0.12, +0.04; gap +0.020, +0.080, +0.006, +0.053, -0.005): hump-shaped in the size, because past 0.075 the linear ceiling (0.28 -> 0.73) rises faster than SR_max (0.43 -> 0.78) -- a larger exposure moves the firm's policies and the type becomes linearly visible in the characteristics.
